## Rest vs Delay vs Fix Boxplots - age group

```{r}

avgACW_allEpochs <- read.csv('/Volumes/Hera/Projects/7TBrainMech/scripts/eeg/Shane/Entropy/Results/glasser/allSubjects_glasserRegions_beamforming_allEpochs.csv') %>% mutate(ageGroup = cut(age, c(0,18,Inf), labels = c('Adol','Adults')))


lunaize(
  ggplot(data = avgACW_allEpochs, 
         aes(x = ageGroup, y = INT_glasser, fill = interaction(factor(epoch, levels = c("Rest", "Delays", "Fix"))))) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), color = "black", width=0.35) +
    labs(x = "Epoch", y = "ACW", fill = "Task") +
    theme_minimal()
  + scale_fill_manual(values = c( "#012b0d", "#27763d", "#90b8a6"))) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 20, color = c("black")),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, color = c("black")),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20,  color = c("black")),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .2), 
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = .2),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white")) + facet_wrap(~region)

wide <- avgACW_allEpochs %>%
  unite("epoch_region", epoch, region, sep = "_") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "epoch_region", values_from = INT_glasser)


t.test(wide$Delays_Frontal, wide$Rest_Frontal, paired = TRUE)
t.test(wide$Delays_Occipital, wide$Rest_Occipital, paired = TRUE)
t.test(wide$Delays_Parietal, wide$Rest_Parietal, paired = TRUE)



wideAdol <- wide %>% filter(ageGroup == 'Adol')

t.test(wideAdol$Delays_Frontal, wideAdol$Rest_Frontal, paired = TRUE)
t.test(wideAdol$Delays_Occipital, wideAdol$Rest_Occipital, paired = TRUE)
t.test(wideAdol$Delays_Parietal, wideAdol$Rest_Parietal, paired = TRUE)

t.test(wideAdol$Delays_Frontal, wideAdol$Fix_Frontal, paired = T)
t.test(wideAdol$Delays_Occipital, wideAdol$Fix_Occipital, paired = TRUE)
t.test(wideAdol$Delays_Parietal, wideAdol$Fix_Parietal, paired = TRUE)

t.test(wideAdol$Fix_Frontal, wideAdol$Rest_Frontal, paired = TRUE)
t.test(wideAdol$Fix_Occipital, wideAdol$Rest_Occipital, paired = TRUE)
t.test(wideAdol$Fix_Parietal, wideAdol$Rest_Parietal, paired = TRUE)





wideAdult <- wide %>% filter(ageGroup == 'Adults')

t.test(wideAdult$Delays_Frontal, wideAdult$Rest_Frontal, paired = TRUE)
t.test(wideAdult$Delays_Occipital, wideAdult$Rest_Occipital, paired = TRUE)
t.test(wideAdult$Delays_Parietal, wideAdult$Rest_Parietal, paired = TRUE)

t.test(wideAdult$Delays_Frontal, wideAdult$Fix_Frontal, paired = TRUE)
t.test(wideAdult$Delays_Occipital, wideAdult$Fix_Occipital, paired = TRUE)
t.test(wideAdult$Delays_Parietal, wideAdult$Fix_Parietal, paired = TRUE)

t.test(wideAdult$Fix_Frontal, wideAdult$Rest_Frontal, paired = TRUE)
t.test(wideAdult$Fix_Occipital, wideAdult$Rest_Occipital, paired = TRUE)
t.test(wideAdult$Fix_Parietal, wideAdult$Rest_Parietal, paired = TRUE)
```

## Delay vs fix
```{r}
avgACW_allEpochs <- read.csv('/Volumes/Hera/Projects/7TBrainMech/scripts/eeg/Shane/Entropy/Results/glasser/allSubjects_glasserRegions_beamforming_allEpochs_allregions.csv') %>% mutate(ageGroup = cut(age, c(0,18,Inf), labels = c('Adol','Adults')))

```


```{r}

avgACW_allEpochs <- avgACW_allEpochs %>%
  mutate(epoch = factor(epoch, levels = c("Fix", "Delays")))  # Explicit order

lunaize(
  ggplot(
    data = avgACW_allEpochs %>% filter(epoch %in% c("Fix", "Delays")),
    aes(x = epoch, y = ACW_50, fill = epoch)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), color = "black", width = 0.35) +
    geom_line(aes(group = interaction(lunaid)), alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.1) +
    labs(x = "Epoch", y = "ACW", fill = "Task") +
    theme_minimal()
) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Delays" = "#012b0d", "Fix" = "#27763d")) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.2)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~lobe)

```
# Age of maturation - all regions
```{r}

####  ACW Rate of maturation ----
mgs_data <- avgACW_allEpochs %>% filter(epoch %in% c("Fix", "Delays"))


epochs <- unique(mgs_data$epoch)
regions <- unique(mgs_data$orig_parcelname)
mgs_data$lunaid <- as.factor(mgs_data$lunaid)
mgs_data$epoch <- as.factor(mgs_data$epoch)

results <- data.frame()

# Loop through each combination of epoch and region
  for (loc in regions) {
    
    region_data <- mgs_data %>% filter(orig_parcelname == loc)
    
    wide <- region_data %>%
  unite("epoch_region", epoch, orig_parcelname, sep = "_") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "epoch_region", values_from = ACW_50)
    
delay_col <- paste0("Delays_", loc)
  fix_col   <- paste0("Fix_", loc)
  
  test <- t.test(
    wide[[delay_col]],
    wide[[fix_col]],
    paired = TRUE
  )
  
  results <- rbind(
    results,
    data.frame(
      region = loc,
      t = unname(test$statistic),
      df = unname(test$parameter),
      p = test$p.value,
      mean_delay = mean(wide[[delay_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_fix = mean(wide[[fix_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )
  
}

results$p_bonf <- p.adjust(results$p, method = "bonferroni")
results$significant <- results$p_bonf < 0.05

results <- results %>%
  rename(orig_parcelname = region)

glasser_rois <- read.csv('/Volumes/Hera/Projects/7TBrainMech/scripts/eeg/Shane/glasser360_regionlist.csv') %>%
  mutate(roi = gsub('_ROI', '', orig_parcelname)) %>%
  mutate(roi = gsub('L_', 'Left_', roi)) %>%
  mutate(roi = gsub('R_', 'Right_', roi))

## run when remote ------------------------------------------------------------
 glasser <- glasser()
 glasser$data$hemi <- factor(glasser$data$hemi, levels = c('right','left'))
 glasser$data$side <- factor(glasser$data$side, levels = c('medial','lateral'))


results <- results %>% merge(., glasser_rois, by = 'orig_parcelname', all=T) 


## run when remote ------------------------------------------------------------
results <- results %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(label, "_ROI"))


dramatic_palette <- c(
  "#001a08",  # near-black green
  "#012b0d",  # original dark forest
  "#014421",  # deep emerald
  "#27763d",  # original medium green
  "#4fa36a",  # brighter transition
  "#90b8a6",  # original sage
  "#d8efe2",  # pale mint
  "#ffffff"   # white highlight
)




ggplot() +
  theme_void() +
  geom_brain(
    data = results,
    atlas = glasser,
    aes(fill = t)
  ) +
  geom_brain(
    data = results,
    atlas = glasser,
    aes(fill = t),
    colour = "gray50",
    size = 0.05
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours =  rev(dramatic_palette)) + 
  new_scale_fill() +
  geom_brain(
    data = results,
    atlas = glasser,
    aes(fill = significant),
    colour = "gray50",
    size = 0.05
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "TRUE" = alpha("white", 0),
      "FALSE" = "gray80"
    ),
    na.value = alpha("white", 0)
  )+
  theme_void(base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, color = "#014421"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )


```

```{r}

results_lobe <- data.frame()

lobes <- unique(mgs_data$lobe)

for (loc in lobes) {
  
  lobe_data <- mgs_data %>%
    filter(lobe == loc) %>%
    group_by(lunaid, epoch) %>%
    summarise(
      ACW_50 = mean(ACW_50, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  wide <- lobe_data %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = epoch,
      values_from = ACW_50
    )
  
  test <- t.test(
    wide$Delays,
    wide$Fix,
    paired = TRUE
  )
  
  results_lobe <- rbind(
    results_lobe,
    data.frame(
      lobe = loc,
      t = unname(test$statistic),
      df = unname(test$parameter),
      p = test$p.value,
      mean_delay = mean(wide$Delays, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_fix = mean(wide$Fix, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )
}

# Bonferroni correction across lobes
results_lobe$p_bonf <- p.adjust(
  results_lobe$p,
  method = "bonferroni"
)

results_lobe$significant <- results_lobe$p_bonf < 0.05


plot_data <- mgs_data %>%
  group_by(lunaid, lobe, epoch) %>%
  summarise(
    ACW_50 = mean(ACW_50, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = epoch, y = ACW_50, group = lunaid)
) +
  geom_line(
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = epoch),
    shape = 21,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(group = epoch, fill = epoch),
    alpha = 0.8,
    width = 0.5,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#012b0d", "#90b8a6")) + 
  facet_wrap(~ lobe, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "ACW"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )

```
